يعتقدوا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَقِدُوا (yaʕtaqidū) /jaʕ.ta.qi.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# يُعْتَقَدُوا (yuʕtaqadū) /juʕ.ta.qa.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
